# UIT iMap

> An interactive 3D online map for the University of Information Technology (UIT) combined with 360-degree panoramic photos. It enables students, staff, and visitors to look up classrooms and buildings, discover facilities, and navigate the campus efficiently.

## Detailed Information

- **Application**: UIT iMap
- **Description**: An interactive 3D online map for the University of Information Technology (UIT) – VNU-HCM combined with 360-degree panoramic photos. It provides students, staff, and visitors with an intuitive way to navigate the campus, discover facilities, and find information about rooms and buildings.
- **Developer / Author**: University of Information Technology - VNU-HCM (UIT)
- **Copyright**: University of Information Technology - VNU-HCM (UIT)

## Routes & Features

- [/](/): Interactive 3D campus map and main navigation hub.
- [/uit](/uit): Introduction and overview of the University of Information Technology (UIT).
- [/imap](/imap): Information about the UIT iMap application and its features.
- [/transport](/transport): Transport schedule and bus routes accessing the campus.
- [/schedule](/schedule): Event schedule and timetable for classrooms and campus locations.
- [/hotspot/:id](/hotspot/:id): Detailed information for specific campus hotspots and buildings.
- [/hotspot/:id/:roomId](/hotspot/:id/:roomId): Detailed information for specific rooms within campus hotspots.
- [/scene/:sceneId](/scene/:sceneId): 360-degree panoramic virtual tour for specific campus scenes.
